help.title: One life. One big dream.
steps: Each turn is one year, from age 11 to 36.
Divide your monthly money into jars. Needs come first.
Spend your little-joys jar in the shop, if you like.
Make choices on the cards. Press Why? to see the reason.
Ammamma's glasses reveal tricky words. Documents hide red flags: tap them.
At the end, replay one decision in a Parallel Life.

exchange.asks: Sellers waiting (asks): cheapest at the bottom
exchange.bids: Buyers waiting (bids): highest at the top

market.buy: Buys right now from the cheapest sellers. Fast, but you take whatever price is there.
market.sell: Sells right now to the highest buyers. Fast, but you take whatever price is there.

limit.buy: Buys only at your price or lower. If no seller is there, your order waits in the book.
limit.sell: Sells only at your price or higher. If no buyer is there, your order waits in the book.

exchange.fee: Brokerage {fee} for each order that trades.

err.qty: Enter a whole number of shares.
err.noShares: You don't have that many shares to sell. Shares in your waiting sell orders are already promised.
err.noCash: Not enough practice cash for this order plus {fee} brokerage.
err.selfTrade: Your own order is on the other side. An exchange won't let you trade with yourself: cancel it first.
err.empty: No one is on the other side right now. Try a limit order.
err.priceBand: Exchanges only accept prices near the last trade (now {lo} to {hi}). This price band stops costly typing mistakes.

exchange.reserved: Promised to your waiting orders: {cash} and {shares} shares.
exchange.ahead: {n} shares ahead of you at this price

explain.read: The best bid ({bid}) is the most anyone will pay right now. The best ask ({ask}) is the least anyone will sell for. The gap, {spread}, is the spread. A trade happens only when a buyer and a seller agree on a price. Tapping a price puts it in your order.
explain.bought: You bought {qty} shares from {n} waiting sell order(s), at an average of {avg} (the best ask was {best}). Brokerage {fee}.
explain.sold: You sold {qty} shares to {n} waiting buy order(s), at an average of {avg} (the best bid was {best}). Brokerage {fee}.
explain.slippage: Your order was bigger than the shares at the best price, so it ate through {levels} price levels. Average {avg} against the best {best}: that extra {cost} is called slippage.
explain.profit: You sold above your average buying price: about {gain} profit after brokerage.
explain.restedBuy: No seller was at {price} or lower, so {qty} shares wait in the book as a bid. {ahead} shares are ahead of you at this price: older orders at the same price fill first (time priority).
explain.restedSell: No buyer was at {price} or higher, so {qty} shares wait in the book as an ask. {ahead} shares are ahead of you at this price: older orders at the same price fill first (time priority).
explain.cancelled: {qty} shares could not be filled (not enough cash, or no one left on the other side), so that part of the market order was cancelled.
explain.passiveBuy: {name} sold {qty} at {price} and hit your waiting buy order. You didn't chase the price: the seller came to you.
explain.passiveSell: {name} bought {qty} at {price} from your waiting sell order. The buyer came to you.
explain.cancel: Order cancelled. Its money or shares are free again.

read.title: Read the order book
read.how: Tap any price in the book. Red rows are sellers, green rows are buyers.
read.learned: Nobody sets the price: it is wherever buyers and sellers meet. The gap between them is the spread.

market.title: Buy with a market order
market.how: Choose Buy → Market, 5 shares, and send it.
market.learned: A market order fills at once at the best price waiting on the other side: speed over price.

limit.title: Place a limit order
limit.how: Choose Limit and set a buy price below the best ask. Your order joins the queue in the book.
limit.learned: A limit order controls the price but not the timing. Orders at the same price wait in line: first come, first served.

limitFill.title: Get your limit order filled
limitFill.how: Wait for a seller to reach your price, or set it just one rupee below the best ask.
limitFill.learned: When someone else's order hits yours, you trade at your price. Patient orders supply the shares that hurried traders take.

slippage.title: See slippage
slippage.how: Send a market buy bigger than the shares at the best ask. Watch it climb the book.
slippage.learned: Big orders eat through several price levels. In a thin market, slippage can cost more than brokerage.

profit.title: Sell for a profit
profit.how: Sell shares for more than your average price. A limit sell above it works.
profit.learned: Profit is the sell price minus the buy price minus fees. Every trade pays brokerage, so trading too often costs money.

news.title: Watch news move the price
news.how: Keep the market running. News arrives every minute or so.
news.learned: News changes how many people want to buy or sell. The order book shows it first: one side empties, and the price moves.

exchange.allDone: You know how an exchange works: bids, asks, the spread, market and limit orders, the queue, slippage and news. Real investing is owning good businesses for years, not quick trades.
exchange.practice: Practice money only: nothing here touches your real savings. Real exchanges work the same way, with millions of orders a second.

insuranceRush.name: Insurance Rush
insuranceRush.goal: Drive as far as you can. While your insurance is active, a crash is a claim: the car gets fixed and you keep going. Crash with an expired policy and it's over!
insuranceRush.how: Hold the arrow keys (or the buttons) to steer. Grab 🛡️ to renew your policy: it costs 3 coins.
insuranceRush.lesson: Insurance only helps if it's active when the accident happens. Keep money for the premium and renew on time.

patangMarket.name: Patang Market
patangMarket.tag: Fly through the ups and downs
patangMarket.goal: It's Sankranti! Fly your kite through ten years of a share's price. Each ₹500 coin buys shares at that moment's price.
patangMarket.how: Press Space or tap to lift the kite. Dodge the candles and the SELL NOW! panic.
patangMarket.lesson: A dip is a sale: the same ₹500 buys more. Selling in panic turns a dip into a real loss.

priceSnake.name: Price Snake
priceSnake.tag: Eat the years, watch prices grow
priceSnake.goal: Mehngai the price snake eats years. Each +1 year makes a bag of groceries cost more. How many years can you last?
priceSnake.how: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD (or the buttons). Eat the +1 year calendars. Don't hit the walls or yourself.
priceSnake.lesson: Prices grow a little every year, and it adds up: at 6% a year they double in about 12 years. Money kept in a tin box can buy less and less, so your savings need to grow too.

swipeBazaar.lesson: Friends' approval fades fast. EMIs and loan-app debts don't. Pause and check the full price before you say yes.

need.name: Needs
need.what: Swipe to pay. If you miss one, you pay a fine.

want.name: Wants
want.what: Cost money now. Friends like it, for a while.

emi.name: Pay later (EMI)
emi.what: ₹0 now, then an EMI every month after. It chains your wallet.

loan.name: Loan apps
loan.what: Instant cash, hidden fees, big repayments, angry messages.

coin.name: Savings coins
coin.what: Swipe to save ₹200. Save in a row for a combo bonus.

intro.think: Think first ({n} uses): slows time and shows the true total cost of everything.
intro.controls: Swipe with your finger or mouse. Press T or Space to think first.

threats: Pay ₹1,900 today or we call your contacts!
Final warning: your family will know.

hud.statusHint: What friends think of you. It fades on its own.

note.late: {item} EMI not paid in full: late fee {fee}

sum.title: Month {n} done
sum.squeeze: You won't be able to pay all your needs!
sum.headGood: You saved {saved} and said no {no} times.
sum.headEmi: EMIs will take {amount} of next month's money.
sum.headMissed: You missed {n} needs. Fines come next month.
sum.headSqueeze: Next month you can't pay for all your needs.

take.emi: You paid {extra} extra for a {item} your friends stopped talking about by week 2.
take.loan: The 'instant' loan gave you {got} and took back {total}. Loan apps are traps.
take.needs: You missed {n} needs. Pay needs first, then think about wants.
take.saver: You said no {no} times and saved {amount}. That's real freedom.
take.default: Every swipe is a choice. Pausing before you buy is a superpower.

story.lost: Play again and do a little better to unlock this choice.
story.freeText: Now let's see what you choose.

ratguard.title: Rat Guard
ratguard.ask1: Kanna, the rats are back tonight! Where do we keep our ₹12,000?
ratguard.ask2: They got in. Where do we keep the rest now?
ratguard.ate: One got in… ₹500 chewed to bits!
ratguard.ateAgain: They got in again. Another ₹500 gone.
ratguard.safe: Not one rupee lost! The rats can't get into a bank, kanna.
ratguard.lostAgain: A tin box can't keep rats out, kanna. Next time, let's try the bank.
ratguard.lesson: Cash at home can be eaten, stolen or burnt. A bank account keeps it safe, and your money is insured up to ₹5 lakh.
ratguard.how: Click a rat (or press Space) to shoo it away.
ratguard.tag: Guard Ammamma's savings from the rats. Play again any time this chapter.
ratguard.holds: The vault holds! The rats give up and run.
ratguard.howBank: Swat them if you like: in the bank, rats just bounce off.

garden.title: SIP Garden
garden.lead: Three mutual funds and an FD lead to your vault. Your money buys units of a fund at today's NAV (its price per unit); the more a lane is worth, the harder its defender fights. Keep thieves out for 3 years.

def.equity: Equity fund: NAV climbs fastest but swings. Fires rockets; wilts in a crash.
def.debt: Debt fund: steady NAV. Shield cannon; thieves steal half as fast.
def.gold: Gold fund: NAV in between. Hits inflation twice as hard.
def.fd: Fixed deposit: value never moves, pays interest coins. Inflation eats it.

inflation.name: Inflation goblin
inflation.tip: Slow, but in every lane, carrying away your money's value.

debt.name: Debt goblin
debt.tip: Fast, dragging a loan's ball and chain.

raccoon.name: Market-drop raccoon
raccoon.tip: Comes in the crash year, after your equity.

scam.name: Scam shadow
scam.tip: Shots pass through. Tap it to report it, or it grabs 20% of a lane.

garden.step1: Tap falling coins and notes ({n} each): your salary.
garden.step2: Tap a lane (or press 1–4) to invest {n}: you get units at today's NAV, and the defender levels up.
garden.step3: Turn on Auto-SIP: it buys ₹50 of every lane each month, more units when the NAV is low. Thieves hit every lane, so spread out.
garden.cashHint: Money in hand: tap coins to get more
garden.crashSub: Equity wilts for a moment. Stay invested.
garden.sipShort: Not enough cash for this month's SIP
garden.lostTitle: The thieves broke into your vault
garden.youPut: What you put in each lane
garden.wonLesson: Every lane had money, so every defender fought back. That's diversification across funds, and a SIP keeps adding to all of them, buying more units when prices are low.
garden.lostLesson: They got through the {lane} lane, where you had put only {n}. Thieves (and bad years) hit every kind of investment: spread your money across funds.
garden.sipNote: Auto-SIP invested for you {n} months in a row.
garden.how: Tap coins · tap a lane or press 1–4 to buy units · S: Auto-SIP · P: pause
garden.crashAskOn: Your SIP keeps buying every month, and now each ₹50 gets 25% more units. Keep it going?
garden.crashAskOff: Units are 25% cheaper now. Start a SIP?
garden.crash_kept: You kept your SIP going in the crash, so it bought equity units cheap. That's rupee-cost averaging.
garden.crash_stopped: You stopped your SIP in the crash, just when units were cheapest. Staying invested usually pays.
garden.crash_started: You started a SIP when prices fell: it bought units cheap.
garden.crash_skipped: In the crash, units were 25% cheaper. A SIP would have bought more of them.

walk.title: Walk the village
walk.text: Follow the pin to where your story happens. Use the arrow keys, or just click a place.

jars.title: Give every rupee a home
jars.text: Each year, split your money into jars. Needs first, then joys, then your dream.

choose.title: Choose wisely
choose.text: Every scene has a few choices. If a red STOP sign flashes, think again!

learn.title: Learn with Ammamma
learn.text: After each choice she shows you why. Tap Learn more for the full lesson.

dream.title: Reach your big dream
dream.text: Live from age 11 to 36. Play the mini-games in the Arcade any time.

fineprint.title: Fine Print Hunter
fineprint.lead: QuickCash says "only 1.5% a month". The bank says 13% a year. Which is really cheaper?
fineprint.step1: Tap the hidden charges in the agreement
fineprint.step2: Work out what you really pay back
fineprint.rule: Find {need} of {total} hidden charges and pick the cheaper loan.
fineprint.wonText: You read the fine print and chose the cheaper loan. Always ask: how much in hand, how much back?
fineprint.lostText: The ad looked cheap, but the fine print wasn't. Try again!
fineprint.ad: ₹20,000 loan at ONLY 1.5% a month! No hidden charges!

phase.total: 🧮 What do you really pay back?

clause.fee: Processing fee: 5% of the loan, taken before you get it.
clause.rate: Interest: 1.5% a month, on the full ₹20,000 every month.
clause.insurance: Loan insurance of ₹1,200 is added to your loan.
clause.due: Instalment due on the 5th of every month.
clause.late: Late payment: ₹100 for every day late.

fineprint.totalQ: In 12 months, how much will you pay QuickCash back?

mistake.ad: ❌ That's "1.5%" once. It's 1.5% every month for 12 months.
mistake.interestOnly: ❌ Close! You forgot the ₹1,200 insurance they added.

fineprint.per100: For every ₹100 you get, you pay back ₹{n}
fineprint.bankTag: {rate}% a year on what you still owe, {fee} fee
fineprint.pickedQuick: ❌ "1.5%" sounds small, but you pay back much more. Look at ₹ for every ₹100.

hello.title: You got your own phone!
hello.text: A phone of your very own! It can make money smarter, or lose it faster. Let's see what's inside.

messages.title: Messages
messages.text: Texts from family, friends and the bank. Scammers text too: never share an OTP or PIN.

bank.title: Your bank
bank.text: See your savings, put money in or take it out, and watch interest add up.

invest.title: Grow your money
invest.text: Start an RD, FD or SIP. Small amounts every month grow big over time.

exchange.title: Practice share market
exchange.text: Buy and sell shares at pretend prices. Learn the ups and downs before risking real money.

arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.text: All the mini-games in one place. Play any time you need a break.

gyaan.title: Gyaan
gyaan.text: Every lesson you've unlocked, as quick picture cards with a quiz.

ready.title: All set!
ready.text: Your phone is in the top bar. Open it whenever you like.

phoneTour.keyHint: opens it from anywhere on the map

pause.title: Paused
pause.text: Take a breath. Time has stopped in the village, and every countdown waits for you.

save.title: Save first?
save.how2: Safety jar fills first, then your dream

news.title: Black Monday!
news.text: Markets just fell 22% in a month. Your phone is buzzing with panic messages.

flood.title: Flood Rescue
flood.then: Then: grab {n} things before the water does!
flood.title_lostPapers: Insured, but the papers floated away
flood.lesson_covered: Insurance turned a disaster into a delay.
flood.lesson_lostPapers: Keep your policy and ID safe, with a copy on your phone. The claim is slow without them.
flood.lesson_noCover: {premium} of crop insurance would have brought back {crop}.

cut.title: Two old ages
cut.stop: At 60, work stops. Your pay stops. Your bills don't.

sixty.without: Only a small jar of savings.

medicine.without: A medicine bill empties the jar.
medicine.with: The monthly money pays the bill.

help.without: Children are busy. You borrow from the sahukar.
help.with: Tea with the grandchildren. You even give them gifts.

cut.lesson: Start early: small drops every month fill a big pot. Old you will thank you.
